system.description: When you go to a meet to get paid by your employer, roll and add the number of unfilled segments on the Legwork Clock.

success.value:
Choose 3 from the list below:
• it's not a set-up or an ambush
• you are paid in full
• the meeting doesn't attract the attention of outside parties
• the employer is identifiable
• you learned something from the mission; everyone marks experience

partial.value:
Choose 1 from the list below:
• it's not a set-up or an ambush
• you are paid in full
• the meeting doesn't attract the attention of outside parties
• the employer is identifiable
• you learned something from the mission; everyone marks experience
